unsupported: Quota is not available for this provider.
disabled: Enable this credential to refresh quota.
notDownloadable: This credential cannot be downloaded. Use a saved credential to check quota.
invalidCredential: The credential file is invalid. Upload a valid credential and retry.
missingIdentity: The credential has no auth index. Refresh the credential list and retry.
invalidResponse: The provider returned an invalid quota response. Refresh quota to retry.
emptyData: The provider returned no quota data. Refresh quota to retry.
missingProject: The credential has no project ID. Refresh its authentication and retry.
missingDca: The Meta credential has no valid DCA token. Sign in again and retry.
metaFailed: The Meta quota request failed. Check the credential and retry.
pluginUnsupported: This credential has no plugin quota route. Update the server and retry.
pluginMissing: No registered quota plugin matches this credential. Check the plugin configuration and retry.
noWindows: The provider did not report quota windows.
sessionChanged: The connection changed. Reload this credential before retrying.
resetCreditConfirm: Spend one reset credit to reset Codex limits for {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
pluginResetConfirm: Reset quota for {{name}} through its provider plugin? This may spend a reset credit.
resetNotConfirmed: The provider did not confirm the reset. Refresh quota before trying again.
cooldownFailed: Quota was reset, but the routing cooldown could not be cleared. Clear the credential's cooldown manually.
actionBusy: Another quota action is running for this account. Wait for it to finish.
allowOverageConfirm: Allow apps using the ChatGPT plan for {{name}} to spend personal credits after reaching the plan limit? This changes the account user's setting and may incur charges.
blockOverageConfirm: Block apps using the ChatGPT plan for {{name}} from spending personal credits after reaching the plan limit? This changes the account user's setting.
overageUnconfirmed: The write may have reached ChatGPT. Only retrying the same value is allowed for this session; an earlier write may still arrive later.
overageOpposite: An earlier write is unconfirmed. Retry the same value instead.
overageFailed: ChatGPT refused the setting change. Check the credential and retry.
missingAccount: The credential has no ChatGPT account ID. Refresh its authentication and retry.
grantConfirm: Choose a reset grant for {{name}}. Redeeming a grant spends one reset and cannot be undone.
grantAuth: Claude refused authorization. Sign in again and refresh grants.
grantRateLimited: Claude rate-limited the request. Wait before refreshing grants.
grantReadFailed: Could not read Claude reset grants. Refresh grants to retry.
grantInvalid: Claude returned invalid grant data. Refresh grants before redeeming.
grantProfileFailed: Could not verify the Claude organization. Refresh grants and retry.
grantIdentityChanged: The Claude organization changed. Sign in again before retrying.
grantUnavailable: The selected grant is no longer available. Refresh grants and choose again.
grantUnknown: The claim outcome is unknown. Retry the same claim; do not spend a different grant.
grantPending: An earlier claim is unresolved. Only its original grant and request ID can be retried within 10 minutes. After that, check the account directly before starting a new session.
grantExpiredRetry: The unresolved claim cannot be retried after 10 minutes or with a different grant. Check the account directly before starting a new session.

grantBlocked.notUsable: This grant is not usable now.
grantBlocked.notLimited: The account must reach its limit first.
grantBlocked.noUsage: No usage needs to be refilled.
grantBlocked.cooldown: The reset cooldown is still active.

grantResult.already_used: Claude confirmed that this claim was already used.
grantResult.not_limited: Claude did not reset quota because the account is not limited.
grantResult.cooldown: Claude refused the reset because a cooldown is active.
grantResult.ineligible: Claude refused the reset because the account is not eligible.
grantResult.unavailable: Claude reported that the grant is unavailable.
grantResult.rate_limited: Claude rate-limited the claim. Wait before retrying.
grantResult.auth_error: Claude refused authorization. Sign in again before retrying.
grantResult.cooldown_clear_failed: Claude confirmed the reset, but the routing cooldown could not be cleared. Clear it manually.
